title: Pre-Collect Conversions and the Early-Termination Charge — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
## Schedule of the pre-collect reduction

A pre-collect reduction applies to the early-termination charge on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements where the client's flat-fee pre-collect program that names this contingency agreement for conversions is active. The program is the client's holding under the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs; its status, and the debtors converted from it to contingency collection, are read from the program record and its unit history.

| Pre-collect program naming this contingency agreement for conversions | Debtors converted to contingency collection in the 12 months before the handling date | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| active | 3 or more | 10 percent |
| active | 1 or 2 | 5 percent |
| active | none | nothing |
| not active | any number | nothing |
| none held | — | nothing |

Stated as a clause: it is 10 percent where 3 or more of its debtors were converted to contingency collection in the 12 months before the handling date, 5 percent where it is active and 1 or 2 were converted in those 12 months, and nothing otherwise.

## Notes to the schedule

1. *The 12 months.* A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date. A conversion counts when its date lies in the window ending on the handling date.
2. *How the reduction acts.* The reduction is a share of the early-termination charge after any proration of the fee. It is added together with any other reduction that applies to the same charge into one reduction share, and the charge after proration is reduced once by the share that results; the reductions do not act one after another.

## Hypothetical readings

- Handling date 2026-07-31; an active program naming the contingency agreement shows conversions on 2025-07-31, 2025-11-03 and 2026-05-19. The window covers the dates after 2025-07-31 up to and including 2026-07-31, so 2 conversions count: 5 percent.
- The same program with one more conversion on 2026-07-31 itself: 3 conversions count, 10 percent.
- A program that converted 5 debtors in the window but is no longer active: nothing.
